text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After she suffers an injury, I<n>hurriedly escort
Seeking the Pearl to<n>the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Haha, you don't need to be so<n>worried.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Of course, I know you must feel<n>impatient. That's
just proof of how<n>much you care about achieving
our<n>dream.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Why don't you observe me while I do<n>a light jog?
If we can figure out how<n>far I can push myself, it'll
be easier to<n>put together a recovery plan for me.
choice_data_list: No, I don't want you to strain yourself.
...All right. Let's see what you've got.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Oh... Well, I get where you're coming<n>from.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
In that case, you'd better get ready<n>for the new and
improved me! When<n>I'm back on my feet again, I'll
be<n>shining like a dazzling pearl!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Yesss! Let's head to the racetrack,<n>then!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Whew... There's not going to be<n>much I can do if
even this level of<n>exertion hurts...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
It probably won't be safe if I try push<n>myself any
further.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, Seeking the Pearl decides to<n>rest until her
injury is fully healed.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! I can run without any<n>issues. My
recovery should be<n>smooth sailing at this rate!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
As long as I don't lose hope, I'll keep<n>on shining
evermore!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: That is my answer to your feelings!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl manages to recover<n>without issue
thanks to her strength<n>of will.
